starters.note: TBD starters are accepted but counted: starter resolution moved 8/17 probabilities ~5x more than form freshness, so a TBD-heavy slate is a materially weaker card.
starters.consequence_if_absent: no slate means no card at all, and no first pitch to time the other inputs against. This is the 2026-08-16 failure exactly.

schedule.consequence_if_absent: the slate count is unverified — tier1_board_gate can only report COMPLETE_BY_ROSTER_PARTITION, never a confirmed game count

prices.consequence_if_absent: no break-even probability, no edge, no selection, and nothing to grade against a market. Model output is forecast-only.
